title: Blank standard forms
owner: Synthetic evaluation fixture (test-only; not CDIT policy)

sections.heading: Get a blank copy of a standard form
sections.text: Blank standard forms are in Forms > Standard Forms. The list includes the Employee Update Form (FRM-EU-01) and the Leave Request Form (FRM-LR-02). Users download a blank copy themselves; Staff share the location, not a filled-in form.

steps.text: Tell the User that blank standard forms are in Forms > Standard Forms.
Ask the User to open Forms, then Standard Forms, and download the blank form they need.

information_needed.prompt: The name of the form the User needs, as stated by the User.

stop_conditions.text: If the User asks Staff to fill in or submit a form for them, or the form is not listed, stop and hand the case to an Admin for human review.
